criterionWitnesses.sourceWitness: Original whole concept: right large portrait has dark eyes/strong brows, warm medium-brown textured skin, calm closed mouth with a slight smile, clear cheek/jaw, dark chin-length side-parted bob with soft flyaways; left complete figure provides relaxed clothed shoulder/limb proportions.
criterionWitnesses.candidateWitness: Right portrait preserves those same visible facial relationships, skin texture, eye/brow/mouth language and side-parted bob silhouette. Left and middle faces and bob remain recognizably coherent with it; complete figures keep the original relaxed adult proportions.
criterionWitnesses.explanation: Actual face and grooming cues support same-person artist continuity across the two plates. This is a qualitative reading, not biometric identity, ancestry, perceived-gender or registered anatomy proof.

criterionWitnesses.sourceWitness: BRIEF owns sage above-elbow sleeves, open camp collar, relaxed upper-hip untucked hem, sand loose ankle trousers and navy canvas low shoes with warm-ivory flat soles. Original concept instead visibly wears a pale-blue long-sleeve crew knit, charcoal wide trousers and brown boots.
criterionWitnesses.candidateWitness: Both complete figures visibly have short sage sleeves ending on the upper arms, flat open collar, small pale buttons and a relaxed near-straight untucked hem. Sand loose straight trouser legs end above the low shoe uppers with small ankle intervals. Both figures wear coherent rounded navy lace-up canvas shoes with matching pale laces and slim warm-ivory soles.
criterionWitnesses.explanation: The sleeves, neckline, lighter palette, ankle hems and low footwear create an observable seasonal wardrobe contrast. The waistband is partly shirt-covered, which BRIEF explicitly permits; this establishes no hidden construction or cooling.

criterionWitnesses.sourceWitness: BRIEF asks for light matte woven shirt with small soft-crisp folds, smoother matte trouser fold language, and canvas upper versus flat sole separation.
criterionWitnesses.candidateWitness: The sage shirt shows a fine crosshatched/slub-like weave and shallow crisp creases, enlarged in the portrait. The sand trousers have longer softer vertical folds/creases and a quieter fine surface. The darker navy shoe uppers, pale crossing laces and smooth light sole bands remain distinct.
criterionWitnesses.explanation: Surface scale, folds, palette and shoe-edge contrast separate the visible clothing roles at plate scale. The trousers retain some woven texture; they read smoother in fold/surface language than the shirt, not as physically different measured materials. No textile process, thickness, opacity or fabric optics is qualified.

criterionWitnesses.sourceWitness: BRIEF requests complete front and three-quarter clothed figures plus a larger whole-head portrait. Ordinary far-side overlap and intentional portrait chest cropping are allowed; head/hair cropping is not.
criterionWitnesses.candidateWitness: The left figure reads front. The middle figure uses a modest oblique stance, more strongly turned head and obliquely shown shoe sides; its torso is less turned than its head. Both have whole hair/head boundaries, both hands and every visible shoe inside frame, with space above hair and below soles. The right portrait has its full bob/crown/head inside the image, and intentionally crops shoulders/chest. Garment palette, collar, placket/hem, trouser lengths and shoe design remain coherent across visible views.
criterionWitnesses.explanation: The middle is useful as a shallow three-quarter discussion stance, not a measured45-degree or strong side-depth master. Its actual stance and visible shoe/collar perspective, rather than its label alone, are sufficient for this outfit comparison. Quiet grey surroundings and soft light preserve garment edges and unobscured face.
